interventions.description: Designate protected pedestrian walkways through the parking lot to connect the public sidewalk directly to store entrances.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Buffers
interventions.description: Add a planting strip or street trees between the sidewalk and the roadway to provide physical and psychological separation from traffic.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks and RRFBs
interventions.description: Install marked crosswalks with Rectangular Rapid Flashing Beacons to alert drivers to the presence of pedestrians.
